roles.title: Aviation Department Manager
roles.rationale: The family office's internal aviation executive who owns the whole program end to end — budget, hiring, vendor selection, and reporting to the principal — functioning as the owner's representative would on a yacht, distinct from any outsourced management company contact.
roles.firms: Aviation Personnel International (API), L&L International, Solairus Aviation (executive placement)
roles.coi_influence: Owns budget, hiring, and vendor selection end to end — the single internal gatekeeper for every external relationship in the program.

roles.title: Owner Trustee (Aircraft Title-Holding Trust Company)
roles.rationale: Holds registered legal title to the aircraft on the FAA N-number registry on behalf of a non-US-citizen beneficial owner, the structural mechanism that makes Part 91 ownership by a foreign family possible at all.
roles.firms: Bank of Utah, Wilmington Trust Company, Wells Fargo Trust Company N.A.
roles.coi_influence: A structural precondition for foreign ownership on the N-register, not a discretionary relationship — without it the aircraft cannot be registered at all.

roles.title: Aviation Attorney
roles.rationale: Negotiates and drafts the purchase agreement, management agreement, and any charter agreement, and structures the holding entity — the aviation industry's direct analogue to admiralty/maritime counsel.
roles.firms: Vedder Price, Jetlaw LLC, Aerlex Law Group, Holland & Knight (Aviation Practice)
roles.coi_influence: Structures the deal before any other advisor is engaged and can gate timing on the whole transaction.

roles.title: Aviation Tax & Structuring Advisor
roles.rationale: Plans bonus depreciation, state sales/use tax exposure on acquisition, federal excise tax on any charter revenue, and personal-use income imputation under the SIFL rules — often the single biggest driver of whether and how the aircraft is bought at all.
roles.firms: GKG Law (Aviation Tax Practice), Advocate Consulting Legal Group, PwC Private Client Aviation, Deloitte Aviation Tax
roles.coi_influence: Often the single biggest driver of whether and how the aircraft is bought at all — bonus depreciation and sales/use tax exposure can swap the entire structure.

roles.title: Flight Department Accountant / Bookkeeper
roles.rationale: Runs the flight department's operating budget and allocates every flight's cost between the owner's personal use and any Part 135 charter use, the allocation the IRS and FAA both scrutinize.
roles.firms: Solairus Aviation (Flight Dept Accounting Services), Aviation Financial Consulting LLC, Priester Aviation (Managed Accounting)

roles.title: SMS Accountable Executive
roles.rationale: Holds ultimate, personally-named regulatory accountability for the safety management system under the operator's FAA authority or IS-BAO program, whether or not they touch day-to-day operations.
roles.firms: Baldwin Aviation Safety & Compliance, ARGUS PROS, Web Manuals
roles.coi_influence: Carries personally-named regulatory liability under FAA or IS-BAO authority regardless of day-to-day operational involvement.

roles.title: Part 135 Director of Operations (DO)
roles.rationale: One of the FAA-required named management positions on the charter management company's Part 135 air carrier certificate, personally accountable to the FAA for every charter flight flown on that certificate.
roles.firms: Solairus Aviation, Jet Linx Aviation, Gama Aviation, Priester Aviation, Directional Aviation (Flexjet)
roles.coi_influence: Named on the air carrier certificate — can single-handedly delay or block a charter placement.

micro_nodes.title: Chief Inspector
micro_nodes.rationale: The fourth FAA-required named management position on a Part 135 certificate, distinct from the DO — owns the certificate's inspection program.

roles.title: IS-BAO / ARGUS / Wyvern Safety Auditor
roles.rationale: Performs the independent third-party operational safety audit that underwriters price against and that charter brokers require before they will book a flight on the aircraft.
roles.firms: ARGUS International, Wyvern Ltd, IBAC (International Business Aviation Council — IS-BAO program)
roles.coi_influence: Audit outcome directly gates insurability and charter-broker acceptance of the aircraft.

roles.title: Aviation Insurance Broker
roles.rationale: Places and negotiates the hull and liability program across the London and US specialty markets and is the client's single point of contact for the entire insurance relationship.
roles.firms: Marsh (Aviation & Aerospace Practice), Global Aerospace, WTW Aviation, Aon Aviation, Leading Edge Aviation Insurance Solutions
roles.coi_influence: Often the real COI bottleneck — the client's single point of contact across the entire insurance relationship.

roles.title: Aviation Underwriter (Hull & Liability)
roles.rationale: Prices and binds the policy based on pilot experience, aircraft type, and operational profile, and is the counterparty the broker negotiates terms against on the client's behalf.
roles.firms: Global Aerospace, USAIG (U.S. Aircraft Insurance Group), Starr Aviation, AIG Aerospace, Chubb Aviation

micro_nodes.title: Hull Underwriter
micro_nodes.rationale: Large placements routinely split hull and liability across different market lines with distinct underwriters.

micro_nodes.title: Liability Underwriter
micro_nodes.rationale: Liability capacity is frequently placed separately from hull, especially on charter-cleared or higher-limit programs.

roles.title: Aviation Claims Adjuster
roles.rationale: Investigates and settles hull damage or liability claims after an incident, becoming the client's primary point of contact for the duration of any loss.
roles.firms: Crawford & Company (Aviation), International Aviation Surveyors, Global Aerospace Claims
roles.coi_influence: Becomes the client's primary point of contact for the full duration of any loss — high-touch during a claim, invisible otherwise.

roles.title: Aviation Risk / Loss Control Engineer
roles.rationale: Conducts the pre-bind risk survey of the flight department's training, maintenance, and safety program that directly sets underwriting terms and pricing.
roles.firms: Global Aerospace (Risk Management), USAIG Loss Control, NBAA Safety Programs

roles.title: Aircraft Broker (Sale & Purchase)
roles.rationale: Represents the buyer or seller through sourcing, negotiation, and closing of an aircraft transaction, the direct analogue of a yacht S&P broker.
roles.firms: Jetcraft, Guardian Jet, OGARAJETS, Mente Group, Colibri Aircraft
roles.coi_influence: Controls deal flow and is often the first point of contact before legal or tax advisors are engaged.

roles.title: Pre-Purchase Inspection (PPI) Facility / Technical Representative
roles.rationale: An approved MRO that performs the independent airframe, engine, and logbook inspection the purchase agreement is conditioned on passing.
roles.firms: Duncan Aviation, StandardAero, West Star Aviation, Elliott Aviation, Gulfstream Service Centers

roles.title: Aircraft Title & Escrow Agent
roles.rationale: Holds closing funds and runs the FAA registry lien and title search before releasing funds and recording transfer, a function unique to how US-registered aircraft close.
roles.firms: AIC Title Service, Insured Aircraft Title Service Inc.
roles.coi_influence: Can delay or block closing entirely if a lien or title defect surfaces late — a function unique to how US-registered aircraft close.

roles.title: Aircraft Finance Lender / Lessor
roles.rationale: Provides purchase-money financing or a lease structure and holds a recorded security interest against the aircraft for the life of the loan.
roles.firms: PNC Aviation Finance, Wells Fargo Equipment Finance (Aircraft), Global Jet Capital, Citi Private Bank Aviation Finance
roles.coi_influence: Holds a recorded security interest for the life of the loan — covenants can constrain resale, re-registration, or lease-back decisions.

roles.title: Aircraft Appraiser
roles.rationale: Issues the independent valuation opinion used to support financing terms, the insured hull value, and any estate or tax position on the aircraft.
roles.firms: Aircraft Bluebook, VREF Aircraft Value Reference, Asset Insight

roles.title: Completion Center Project Manager
roles.rationale: Runs a green-delivered aircraft's custom cabin build at an OEM-authorized completion facility, the direct analogue of a shipyard project manager on a new-build yacht.
roles.firms: Gulfstream Completions (Savannah), Bombardier Completion Centre (Montreal/Berlin), AMAC Aerospace, Comlux Completion, Jet Aviation Basel

roles.title: Owner's Technical Representative (Completion / Refit)
roles.rationale: An independent consultant retained solely to inspect and sign off completion or heavy-maintenance work against spec on the owner's behalf, mirroring a yacht owner's site representative.
roles.firms: JSSI Advisors, StandardAero (Owner Technical Representation), Duncan Aviation Technical Representation
roles.coi_influence: The sole party financially aligned with the owner during completion or refit sign-off — no OEM or completion-center payroll conflict.

roles.title: Aircraft Interior Designer
roles.rationale: Designs and specifies the custom cabin interior, materials, and finishes for a new completion or a cabin refurbishment.
roles.firms: Associated Air Center (Dallas), Greenpoint Technologies, AMAC Aerospace Design Studio, Pierrejean Design Studio

roles.title: Chief Pilot / PIC-Captain
roles.rationale: Commands the aircraft and holds ultimate in-flight decision authority, the direct analogue of a yacht captain.
roles.firms: Aviation Personnel International (API), L&L International, Solairus Aviation (crew placement), Jet Linx Aviation
roles.coi_influence: Holds final in-flight decision authority, overriding owner preference on any safety call.

roles.title: Director of Maintenance (DOM)
roles.rationale: Owns the aircraft's continuous airworthiness program and every maintenance release, the direct analogue of a chief engineer.
roles.firms: Aviation Personnel International (API), L&L International, StandardAero, Duncan Aviation
roles.coi_influence: Every maintenance release runs through this one signature — can ground the aircraft unilaterally.

roles.title: First Officer / SIC
roles.rationale: Second-in-command pilot required for most business jet operations and for every Part 135 charter flight regardless of aircraft size.
roles.firms: Aviation Personnel International (API), L&L International

roles.title: Flight Coordinator / Scheduler
roles.rationale: Builds every trip's schedule, tracks pilot duty-time limits, and coordinates passenger logistics, the flight department's day-to-day operational hub.
roles.firms: Solairus Aviation, Priester Aviation, TAG Aviation

roles.title: A&P Maintenance Technician
roles.rationale: Performs hands-on airframe and powerplant maintenance and inspections under the DOM's approved program.
roles.firms: Duncan Aviation, StandardAero, West Star Aviation, Elliott Aviation, Textron Aviation Service Centers

roles.title: Flight Attendant / Flight Technician
roles.rationale: Delivers in-flight cabin service and safety duties on larger-cabin aircraft, required crew on many international and long-range flights.
roles.firms: Cabin Crew Connection, L&L International, Solairus Aviation

roles.title: Safety Manager (SMS Program)
roles.rationale: Runs the day-to-day hazard reporting, risk assessment, and audit cadence of the safety management system on behalf of the Accountable Executive, a distinct operating role from the accountability itself.
roles.firms: Baldwin Aviation Safety & Compliance, ARGUS PROS, Web Manuals

roles.title: Relief / Augmented-Crew Pilot
roles.rationale: A third pilot added for ultra-long-range flights to satisfy FAA and operator crew-rest requirements on flights that exceed standard duty limits.
roles.firms: Aviation Personnel International (API), L&L International, Solairus Aviation

roles.title: Charter Sales Broker / Charter Management Representative
roles.rationale: Books third-party charter revenue flights onto the aircraft when the owner places it on the management company's Part 135 certificate.
roles.firms: Air Charter Service, PrivateFly, Villiers Jets, Magellan Jets, Paramount Business Jets
roles.coi_influence: Controls whether and how the aircraft earns charter revenue against the owner's own personal-use schedule.

roles.title: Trip Planning / Concierge Coordinator
roles.rationale: Arranges ground transport, catering, and destination logistics around the owner's own flights, the aviation analogue of yacht guest-experience concierge.
roles.firms: Universal Aviation (Universal Weather and Aviation), Air Partner, World Fuel Services (Colt International)

roles.title: Aircraft Management Company Account Contact

roles.title: Director of Residence / Chief of Staff
roles.rationale: The family's senior-most household authority holding ultimate signing power over property-level decisions, staff, and vendor relationships across the portfolio, and the person brokers escalate to when a binding decision is needed.
roles.firms: Agreus Group, Polo & Tweed, Silver Swan Recruitment, Mahler Private Staffing
roles.coi_influence: Often the real decision-maker brokers must reach — holds practical signing authority even when a principal is nominally the named insured.

roles.title: Trustee (Real Property Holding Trust)
roles.rationale: When a residence is held in a revocable or irrevocable trust for estate-planning and liability-shielding purposes, the trustee — not the family member living there — is the named insured and the actual signatory on the policy and any binding endorsement.
roles.firms: Northern Trust, Bessemer Trust, U.S. Trust (Bank of America Private Wealth Management), South Dakota Trust Company, Wilmington Trust
roles.coi_influence: Actual signatory of record when title sits in trust; policy changes cannot bind without trustee sign-off.

roles.title: Title-Holding Entity Manager / Registered Agent (LLC/SPV)
roles.rationale: UHNW residences are frequently titled to a single-purpose LLC for privacy and liability segregation, and the entity's manager or registered agent is the low-touch administrative contact needed to confirm named-insured status and entity good-standing at binding and renewal.
roles.firms: CT Corporation, CSC Global, National Registered Agents Inc. (NRAI), Harvard Business Services

roles.title: Property Tax Advisor
roles.rationale: Advises on assessment appeals, exemptions, and reassessment triggers, and their annual valuation work is often the same figure a broker cross-checks against declared replacement cost.
roles.firms: Altus Group, Ryan LLC, Kroll (Duff & Phelps) Property Tax Services, Marvin F. Poer and Company
roles.coi_influence: Their annual valuation is often the same figure a broker cross-checks against declared replacement cost — an informal second opinion on value.

roles.title: Trusts & Estates Counsel
roles.rationale: Drafts and maintains the ownership structure — trust, LLC, or direct title — that determines who the named insured actually is, and must sign off before any change in title or beneficiary triggers a required policy amendment.
roles.firms: Withers, McDermott Will & Emery, Loeb & Loeb, Day Pitney
roles.coi_influence: Must approve any title or beneficiary change before a policy amendment can be triggered — a structural gate, not just an advisory touchpoint.

roles.title: Family Office Controller / Household Bookkeeper
roles.rationale: Pays premium invoices and tracks renewal dates across multiple properties, and is usually the first point of contact a broker's service team reaches for account-level administration rather than the principal.
roles.firms: Pitcairn, Bessemer Trust, Ascent Private Capital Management, Agreus Group
roles.coi_influence: First point of contact for renewal administration; can materially delay binding by withholding payment or documentation.

roles.title: Private Banker / Mortgage Lender Relationship Manager
roles.rationale: Where a residence carries a jumbo mortgage or securities-backed line of credit, the lender's mortgagee-clause and minimum-coverage requirements directly constrain policy structure and must be coordinated at every renewal.
roles.firms: J.P. Morgan Private Bank, Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management, Citi Private Bank, Northern Trust
roles.coi_influence: Mortgagee-clause and minimum-coverage requirements from the lender directly constrain policy structure at every renewal.

roles.title: Flood Zone / FEMA Elevation Certificate Surveyor
roles.rationale: Produces the elevation certificate that sets flood-zone rating and premium for coastal or waterway-adjacent properties, engaged once per property but referenced at every subsequent flood renewal.
roles.firms: NV5, Bock & Clark, Partner Engineering and Science, GeoStar Surveying

roles.title: Wildfire Mitigation / Defensible Space Inspector
roles.rationale: Assesses brush clearance, roofing material, and home-hardening measures against carrier wildfire-underwriting standards; an increasing number of carriers in fire-exposed states now require this inspection as a bind condition.
roles.firms: Chubb Wildfire Defense Services, AIG Private Client Group Wildfire Protection Unit, Wildfire Defense Systems
roles.coi_influence: Increasingly a hard bind condition in fire-exposed states — can block coverage entirely, not just price it.

roles.title: Fire & Life-Safety / Building Code Compliance Consultant
roles.rationale: Manages ongoing compliance with sprinkler, alarm, and local fire-code requirements across the portfolio, and their certification is frequently the documentary basis for a carrier's protective-safeguards endorsement.
roles.firms: Jensen Hughes, Koffel Associates, Code Consultants Inc.
roles.coi_influence: Their certification is frequently the documentary basis for a carrier's protective-safeguards endorsement.

roles.title: Local Insurance Agent of Record
roles.rationale: Holds the state license required to bind admitted-market paper on the property and is the compliance-mandated local signatory even when overall program strategy is set elsewhere.
roles.firms: HUB International, Alliant Private Client, NFP, Risk Strategies Company
roles.coi_influence: Compliance-mandated local signatory even when overall program strategy is set by the private client broker elsewhere — cannot be bypassed for binding admitted paper.

roles.title: Private Client Insurance Broker / Personal Risk Advisor
roles.rationale: Owns the overall risk-transfer strategy across the family's full property portfolio, coordinates every other insurance-market role, and is the principal counterparty relationship for the brokerage itself.
roles.firms: Marsh Private Client Services, Alliant Private Client, Risk Strategies Private Client Group, AON Private Risk Management
roles.coi_influence: The principal counterparty relationship and program architect — the real point of control across the family's full portfolio.

roles.title: Surplus Lines / Wholesale Broker
roles.rationale: Sources non-admitted (E&S) market capacity for coastal, wildfire, or high-value-dwelling risk that admitted carriers decline or won't fully limit — a near-universal need for UHNW coastal and wildfire-zone homes.
roles.firms: CRC Group, Amwins, RT Specialty, Burns & Wilcox
roles.coi_influence: Often the only path to bindable capacity for coastal or wildfire risk that admitted carriers have already declined.

roles.title: Risk Engineer / Loss Control Consultant
roles.rationale: Conducts the pre-bind and periodic renewal survey — roofing, electrical, fire suppression, security systems — whose findings directly set terms, deductibles, and pricing.
roles.firms: Chubb Risk Consulting, AIG Private Client Group Risk Management, PURE Insurance Risk Management Services, FM Global
roles.coi_influence: Their survey findings set terms, deductibles, and pricing directly — a technical gatekeeper, not just an inspector.

roles.title: Claims Advocate / Public Adjuster
roles.rationale: Engaged only after a loss event to document damage and negotiate settlement on the family's behalf, a transaction-level relationship that activates episodically rather than continuously.
roles.firms: Adjusters International, Greenspan Co./Adjusters International, Crawford & Company

roles.title: Luxury Real Estate Broker / Agent
roles.rationale: Leads the buy-side or sell-side transaction and is the decision-driving relationship during any acquisition or disposal, typically the first call before a new property enters the insured portfolio.
roles.firms: Sotheby's International Realty, Christie's International Real Estate, Douglas Elliman, Compass, Engel & Völkers
roles.coi_influence: First call before any new property enters the insured portfolio — sets the acquisition timeline the broker has to work against.

roles.title: Real Estate Closing / Title Attorney
roles.rationale: Executes the legal transfer of title and drafts the purchase agreement, and the resulting deed determines exactly whose name must appear on the new policy.
roles.firms: Katten Muchin Rosenman, Greenberg Traurig, Holland & Knight
roles.coi_influence: The deed they draft determines exactly whose name must appear on the new policy — a direct input, not just a legal formality.

roles.title: Title Company Escrow Officer
roles.rationale: Holds and disburses transaction funds and issues the title insurance policy, a one-time transaction-level role confined to the closing window.
roles.firms: First American Title, Fidelity National Title, Chicago Title, Stewart Title

roles.title: Pre-Purchase Property Inspector / Appraiser
roles.rationale: Delivers the structural inspection and valuation that underpin both the purchase financing and the initial insured replacement-cost figure.
roles.firms: Pillar To Post, Criterium Engineers, Miller Samuel Inc.

roles.title: General Contractor / Construction Manager
roles.rationale: Runs and is accountable for any ground-up build or major renovation, and builder's-risk coverage is placed and monitored against their project schedule and cost reporting.
roles.firms: Streeter Custom Builder, Woodmeister Master Builders, Marmol Radziner, Divco Custom Homes
roles.coi_influence: Project schedule and cost reporting is what builder's-risk coverage is actually monitored against.

roles.title: Architect of Record
roles.rationale: Produces the code-compliant design and stamped drawings a jurisdiction requires for permitting, which also document the structure a builder's-risk or renovation policy is written against.
roles.firms: Robert A.M. Stern Architects, Peter Marino Architect, Ike Kligerman Barkley

roles.title: Interior Designer
roles.rationale: Specifies finishes, art placement, and furnishings whose aggregate value materially drives the contents/personal-property limit on the final policy.
roles.firms: Michael S. Smith Inc., Victoria Hagan Interiors, Kelly Wearstler, Studio Peregalli
roles.coi_influence: Aggregate specification value materially drives the final contents/personal-property limit.

roles.title: Owner's Representative (Construction/Renovation)
roles.rationale: A family-appointed authority who oversees the general contractor and design team on the owner's behalf during active build or refit periods, distinct from day-to-day residence leadership.
roles.firms: Turner & Townsend, CBRE Project Management, JLL Project & Development Services
roles.coi_influence: Delegated spending and scope authority during active builds — the practical point of control while a General Contractor is engaged.

roles.title: Estate Manager
roles.rationale: The senior on-site operational authority for a given residence, responsible for staff, maintenance, and day-to-day risk conditions much as a captain runs a vessel.
roles.firms: Agreus Group, Polo & Tweed, Mahler Private Staffing
roles.coi_influence: The on-site authority for day-to-day risk conditions — the closest analogue to a yacht captain, and the person a claims adjuster deals with directly.

roles.title: Household Manager
roles.rationale: Runs day-to-day domestic operations at a secondary property or under the Estate Manager, filling operational authority where a full Estate Manager isn't warranted.
roles.firms: Agreus Group, Polo & Tweed, Town & Country Resources

roles.title: Director of Security
roles.rationale: Oversees the protection detail, access control, and physical security systems whose specification — monitored alarm, gated access — directly affects underwriting terms and premium credits.
roles.firms: Gavin de Becker & Associates, TorchStone Global, Command Consulting Group
roles.coi_influence: System specification choices (monitored alarm, gated access) directly affect underwriting terms and premium credits.

roles.title: Groundskeeper
roles.rationale: Frontline staff responsible for landscape, irrigation, and exterior upkeep whose condition — dead trees, standing water, brush — is a routine loss-control inspection item.
roles.firms: BrightView Landscape Services, SavATree, Hollander Design Landscape Architects

roles.title: Facilities / Maintenance Engineer
roles.rationale: Maintains HVAC, generators, pool equipment, and building systems whose failure is among the most common sources of water and fire loss on a large residence.
roles.firms: ABM Industries, JLL Facilities Management, CBRE Facilities Management

roles.title: Personal Protection Officer / Bodyguard
roles.rationale: Frontline security personnel reporting to the Director of Security, present at higher-profile residences and relevant to liability exposure from armed or licensed protective staff.
roles.firms: Gavin de Becker & Associates, TorchStone Global, Global Guardian

roles.title: Housekeeper / Domestic Staff
roles.rationale: Frontline household staff whose presence and employment status factor into workers'-compensation and household-employment liability exposure.
roles.firms: Agreus Group, Polo & Tweed, Town & Country Resources

roles.title: Seasonal Rental / Leasing Manager
roles.rationale: Manages any short-term or seasonal letting of a property, converting it from an owner-occupied risk to a tenanted one with materially different exposure and typically a distinct policy endorsement.
roles.firms: Sotheby's International Realty, The Corcoran Group, Douglas Elliman, Onefinestay, Plum Guide
roles.coi_influence: Converts a property from owner-occupied to tenanted risk — a materially different exposure requiring its own endorsement.

roles.title: Estate Events / Function Coordinator
roles.rationale: Organizes private events or functions hosted at the residence — weddings, fundraisers — each a discrete, often separately-insured liability exposure outside normal occupancy.
roles.firms: Colin Cowie Lifestyle, Bronson van Wyck, David Stark Design and Production, Yifat Oren Productions

roles.title: Property Manager
roles.rationale: The third-party professional firm or individual managing vendors, budgets, and maintenance oversight across one or more properties on the family's behalf, the closest analog to a yacht's technical manager.
roles.firms: Cushman & Wakefield, JLL, CBRE, R.A. Nelson & Associates
roles.coi_influence: The closest analogue to a yacht's technical manager — coordinates vendors and budget across the portfolio and is often the de facto point of contact for renewal servicing.

roles.title: Household Payroll & HR Administrator
roles.rationale: Administers household-employee payroll, workers' compensation, and employment-law compliance, a back-office function distinct from on-site operational management.
roles.firms: HomeWork Solutions, GTM Payroll Services, Poppins Payroll, NannyChex

The director of security supervises the personal protection officer's coverage schedule, routes, and protocols.
The director of security relies on the maintenance engineer to keep access control, cameras, and alarm systems physically operational.
The protection officer plans access control and guest screening with the events coordinator whenever a function brings outside guests onto the property.
The payroll administrator processes the housekeeper's hourly timesheets, overtime, and benefits enrollment directly.
The leasing manager reports rental income and the booking calendar to the property manager for portfolio-level accounting.

roles.title: Collection Advisor
roles.rationale: Acts as the principal's primary trusted advisor on the composition, direction, and long-term strategy of the collection, sitting above any single transaction and typically holding authority to instruct other advisors on the owner's behalf.
roles.firms: Hagerty, Kidston SA, Girardo & Co, RM Sotheby's Private Sales, Bonhams Cars Private Treaty
roles.coi_influence: Often the real decision-maker on acquisition and disposal strategy, ahead of any single transaction

roles.title: Family Office / Private Client Representative
roles.rationale: Coordinates the auto collection within the principal's broader wealth structure, acting as the single point of contact across trustees, legal counsel, and the insurance broker so decisions affecting the collection stay consistent with wider estate and liability planning.
roles.firms: Northern Trust, UBS Family Office, Stonehage Fleming, Cazenove Capital, BNY Mellon Wealth Management
roles.coi_influence: Gatekeeper for broker access within the wider estate and liability structure

roles.title: Collection Manager / Curator
roles.rationale: Serves as the principal's day-to-day steward for the physical fleet, making usage, storage, and vendor-coordination decisions across every vehicle and functioning as the collection's embedded equivalent of an owner's representative.
roles.firms: Road Scholars, RM Sotheby's Private Client Services, independent sole-practitioner curators (no agency)
roles.coi_influence: De facto vendor-selection authority; usually the first and most persistent point of contact

roles.title: Collector Vehicle / Chattel Counsel
roles.rationale: Advises on title defects, lien resolution, bailment, and contract disputes specific to high-value personal property transactions, issues that recur given the informal transaction history common to older collector cars.
roles.firms: Withers, Herrick Feinstein, Pryor Cashman, Boodle Hatfield
roles.coi_influence: Can delay or unwind a deal or claim over title defects and provenance disputes

roles.title: Estate & Tax Structuring Advisor
roles.rationale: Determines whether each vehicle sits in personal ownership, an LLC, or a trust for estate and tax purposes, a decision that directly dictates the named insured and the policy structure the broker must place.
roles.firms: EY Private Client Services, PwC Private Client, Withers, Boodle Hatfield, Northern Trust

roles.title: Collection Accountant / Financial Controller
roles.rationale: Tracks acquisition cost basis, restoration capital expenditure, and current market value across the fleet, records the broker relies on to keep agreed-value schedules current and defensible at claim time.
roles.firms: EY, KPMG Family Office Services, Withers Consulting, RSM Private Client
roles.coi_influence: Keeps the cost-basis and valuation records agreed-value schedules and claim settlements depend on

roles.title: Titling Entity / LLC Manager (Trustee)
roles.rationale: Administers the single-purpose LLC or trust that holds legal title to one or more vehicles for liability segregation, a structure common enough in this asset class that the broker must confirm it matches the policy's named-insured wording.
roles.firms: Northern Trust, CT Corporation, Ocorian, Trident Trust, Maples Group
roles.coi_influence: Named-insured wording must match this structure exactly, or a claim can be contested on a technicality

roles.title: Title & Registration Agent
roles.rationale: Manages jurisdictional title transfer, historic/collector plate designation, and registration renewal, paperwork gaps in which are a routine cause of coverage disputes on total-loss claims.
roles.firms: eTags.com, DMV.com Concierge Services, local state/jurisdiction-specific title and registration agents

roles.title: Import, Export & Emissions Compliance Specialist
roles.rationale: Manages Show-or-Display exemptions, the 25-year import rule, and customs clearance for grey-market or foreign-market vehicles; compliance failures here can void registration eligibility and, by extension, insurability.
roles.firms: Toprank International Vehicle Importers, J.K. Technologies, Livingston International (customs brokerage)
roles.coi_influence: A compliance miss here can void registration eligibility and, by extension, insurability outright

roles.title: Marque Authentication Certifier
roles.rationale: Issues manufacturer-recognized certification (a factory heritage or Classiche-type program) confirming chassis, engine, and component originality, a document that materially sets and defends the agreed insured value.
roles.firms: Ferrari Classiche, Porsche Certificate of Authenticity, Bentley Mulliner Heritage, Aston Martin Heritage Certification, FIVA
roles.coi_influence: Certification materially sets and defends the agreed insured value

roles.title: Appraiser / Valuation Specialist
roles.rationale: Produces the independent valuation report each vehicle's agreed-value policy is scheduled against, and is typically re-engaged on a recurring basis as market values for a given marque and model move.
roles.firms: Hagerty Valuation Services, JC Taylor, American Collectors Insurance (valuation desk), K500 Vehicle Valuation, independent ASA-certified appraisers
roles.coi_influence: The broker's agreed-value schedule is only as current as this report

roles.title: Specialty Collector Vehicle Insurance Broker
roles.rationale: Places and negotiates agreed-value policies across the fleet with specialist collector-car underwriters, structuring usage, storage, and driver terms that a standard personal auto policy cannot accommodate.
roles.firms: Hagerty, Grundy Worldwide, American Collectors Insurance, J.C. Taylor, Heacock Classic
roles.coi_influence: Often the single point of renewal authority across the entire fleet

roles.title: Underwriter (Collector Vehicle Markets)
roles.rationale: Prices and accepts risk per vehicle based on declared value, storage conditions, annual mileage, and driver profile, and is the counterparty the broker negotiates policy terms against.
roles.firms: Chubb Collector Car, AIG Private Client Group, Markel Specialty, Travelers, American Modern Insurance Group
roles.coi_influence: The counterparty whose risk appetite ultimately caps what the broker can place

roles.title: Claims Adjuster / Total-Loss Specialist
roles.rationale: Investigates and settles claims on collector vehicles, work that requires marque-specific expertise since a generic adjuster will routinely undervalue bespoke restoration labor and matching-numbers provenance.
roles.firms: Crawford & Company, Sedgwick, J.S. Held, independent marque-specialist adjusters
roles.coi_influence: A generic adjuster will routinely undervalue bespoke restoration and matching-numbers provenance

roles.title: Risk Engineer / Loss-Control Surveyor
roles.rationale: Inspects storage facilities for fire suppression, security, and climate control as a condition of coverage or as a basis for a premium credit, functioning as the underwriter's on-site verification layer.
roles.firms: FM Global, Chubb Risk Engineering, AIG Risk Consulting, XL Catlin Risk Engineering
roles.coi_influence: Survey findings can gate coverage or unlock a premium credit

roles.title: Senior Specialist
roles.rationale: An auction house's in-house expert who sources consignments, authenticates provenance, and advises on reserve and estimate, the primary counterparty when a vehicle enters or exits the collection through the auction channel.
roles.firms: RM Sotheby's, Bonhams, Gooding & Company, Broad Arrow Auctions, Mecum Auctions
roles.coi_influence: Often controls first access when a vehicle enters or exits the collection

roles.title: Private Sale Broker / Marque Dealer
roles.rationale: Negotiates private-treaty acquisitions and sales outside the auction system, the channel favored for the most discreet high-value transactions and often carrying authority to bind a deal on the principal's behalf.
roles.firms: Girardo & Co, Kidston SA, DK Engineering, Tom Hartley Jnr, Fantasy Junction
roles.coi_influence: Can carry authority to bind a deal on the principal's behalf

roles.title: Pre-Purchase Inspector / Marque Specialist Mechanic
roles.rationale: Conducts an independent technical inspection before purchase to verify mechanical condition and originality claims, a report the insurance broker and appraiser both rely on when a newly acquired vehicle is first scheduled.
roles.firms: Canepa, marque-specialist independent shops, manufacturer-authorized dealer service departments
roles.coi_influence: Findings set the initial agreed value on a newly acquired vehicle

roles.title: Transaction Attorney / Escrow Agent
roles.rationale: Holds funds and title documents during a sale or purchase, releasing them only once condition, title, and payment terms are satisfied, mirroring the yacht industry's S&P attorney function for high-value private-property transfer.
roles.firms: Withers, DLA Piper Art & Luxury Assets, First American Title, Escrow.com
roles.coi_influence: Holds funds and title until every condition is satisfied — a hard stop point in the deal

roles.title: Restoration Technician
roles.rationale: Performs the hands-on mechanical, electrical, and trim work of a restoration project, labor whose documentation quality directly supports or undermines the vehicle's insured value going forward.
roles.firms: RM Auto Restoration, Paul Russell and Company, Canepa, Rare Drive

roles.title: Restoration Shop Owner / Project Manager
roles.rationale: Owns and directs a full nut-and-bolt restoration project end to end, coordinating coachwork, mechanical rebuild, and parts sourcing to a concours or matching-numbers standard, and typically holds the client relationship and signs off on project scope and cost.
roles.firms: RM Auto Restoration, Paul Russell and Company, Canepa, Rare Drive, Roos Engineering
roles.coi_influence: Documentation quality from this shop supports or undermines insured value for years afterward

roles.title: Marque Parts Sourcing Specialist
roles.rationale: Locates new-old-stock, reproduction, or fabricated period-correct components for rare and discontinued models, sourcing decisions that can make or break a restoration's originality and therefore its resale and insured value.
roles.firms: Motion Products Inc, Patrick Motorsports, Porsche Classic, Mercedes-Benz Classic Center

roles.title: Engine / Powertrain Rebuild Specialist
roles.rationale: Performs matching-numbers-preserving mechanical rebuilds, typically the single highest-value-at-risk phase of any restoration and a frequent subject of dispute if the work is not independently documented.
roles.firms: Motion Products Inc, Roos Engineering, Patrick Motorsports, factory heritage engine-rebuild programs (Ferrari, Porsche)
roles.coi_influence: Highest-value-at-risk phase of any restoration; frequent subject of valuation disputes

roles.title: Private Collection Technician / In-House Mechanic
roles.rationale: Maintains the day-to-day mechanical readiness of vehicles between events or restoration cycles, a lighter-touch role than the project-level Restoration Technician and the closest analogue to a yacht's onboard engineer.
roles.firms: The Right Recruitment Group, restoration-shop referral networks, direct hire (no agency)

roles.title: Chauffeur / Professional Driver
roles.rationale: Operates vehicles for the principal's use or for transport between storage, service, and events, and is frequently listed as a named or permitted driver on the policy, directly affecting the risk profile underwritten.
roles.firms: Bespoke Chauffeuring, Tiger Recruitment, Polo & Tweed, Blacklane
roles.coi_influence: Named or permitted driver status directly affects the risk profile underwritten

roles.title: Collection Facility Manager / Garage Manager
roles.rationale: Runs the physical storage or display facility day to day — access control, climate systems, vehicle movement scheduling — the on-site staff role a loss-control survey actually assesses.
roles.firms: Road Scholars, direct hire, storage-facility operator staffing
roles.coi_influence: The on-site role a loss-control survey actually assesses

roles.title: Class Judge
roles.rationale: Judges vehicles at concours d'elegance events against marque-specific authenticity and condition standards, and the resulting score becomes part of a car's public value record referenced in future appraisals.
roles.firms: Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance judging panel, Classic Car Club of America (CCCA), Amelia Island Concours judging panel
roles.coi_influence: Judging score becomes part of the vehicle's public value record

roles.title: Selection Committee Member
roles.rationale: Decides which vehicles are invited to participate in a judged concours, an adjacent-industry gatekeeping role that shapes a car's exhibition history and, cumulatively, its market reputation.
roles.firms: Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance, Amelia Island Concours d'Elegance, Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este selection panel
roles.coi_influence: Gatekeeping role shaping exhibition history and market reputation

roles.title: Concours d'Elegance Event Organizer
roles.rationale: Produces judged exhibition events at which entrant vehicles carry elevated exposure — transport, handling, crowd proximity — that typically requires an event-specific insurance rider layered on top of the standing policy.
roles.firms: Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance, Amelia Island Concours, Hampton Court Concours of Elegance, Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este

roles.title: Vintage Rally / Touring Event Organizer
roles.rationale: Organizes road-going rally and touring events that put collector vehicles into active multi-day highway use, a usage pattern requiring temporary transit coverage and driver vetting distinct from static ownership.
roles.firms: Mille Miglia organizing committee, Copperstate 1000, Colorado Grand, Peninsula Classics
roles.coi_influence: Puts vehicles into active multi-day road use, temporarily changing the risk profile

roles.title: Track Day / HPDE Instructor
roles.rationale: Supervises on-track use of performance and hypercar-class vehicles, a usage context that materially changes the risk profile and commonly requires a separate track-day endorsement or signed liability waiver.
roles.firms: Skip Barber Racing School, Radford Racing School, National Auto Sport Association (NASA), Porsche Sport Driving School
roles.coi_influence: Usage context commonly requires a separate track-day endorsement or signed liability waiver

roles.title: Third-Party Collection Management Company
roles.rationale: Provides full outsourced management of the collection — maintenance scheduling, registration renewal, and vendor coordination across every vehicle — the closest auto-world equivalent to a yacht management company, though far less universally adopted in this vertical.
roles.firms: Road Scholars, RM Sotheby's Collection Advisory, Symbolic International
roles.coi_influence: Vendor-coordination hub across every vehicle in the fleet, the closest auto-world equivalent to a yacht management company

roles.title: Collection Storage Facility Operator
roles.rationale: Provides secure, climate-controlled, insured storage, and the facility's security and fire-suppression specification is itself a direct underwriting factor the broker must document.
roles.firms: Road Scholars, Classic Car Club Manhattan, Classic Car Club London, The Bridge (UK)
roles.coi_influence: Facility spec (fire suppression, security, climate control) is itself a direct underwriting factor

roles.title: Specialist Marque Service Center / Authorized Dealer Service
roles.rationale: Performs manufacturer-authorized maintenance and warranty work, particularly important for modern hypercars still under factory warranty, where independent service can void both warranty and certain policy conditions.
roles.firms: Authorized Ferrari/Porsche/Lamborghini dealer service departments, Canepa, Rennsport Systems, Motion Products Inc
roles.coi_influence: Independent service can void both factory warranty and certain policy conditions

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.rationale: Runs the principal's day-to-day affairs and coordinates every advisor and vendor relationship, making them the broker's primary point of contact for program-level decisions and renewal sign-off.
roles.firms: Agreus Group, Hanson Search, Polo & Tweed
roles.coi_influence: Often the actual filter on what reaches the principal — broker access frequently runs through this desk first.

roles.title: Family Office CEO / President
roles.rationale: Heads the single-family office and holds ultimate delegated authority over the family's risk-program budget, vendor selection, and structural decisions such as which entity holds which insured asset.
roles.firms: Bessemer Trust, Pitcairn, Stonehage Fleming, Northern Trust Family Office Services
roles.coi_influence: Final internal sign-off on any major program restructuring or vendor change.

roles.title: Trustee (Individual or Corporate)
roles.rationale: Where a residence, artwork, or vehicle is held in trust rather than in the principal's own name, the trustee is the legal owner and named insured of record, making trustee sign-off a condition of binding or amending that coverage.
roles.firms: Northern Trust, Wilmington Trust, South Dakota Trust Company, Bessemer Trust
roles.coi_influence: Can block or delay a coverage or ownership change that conflicts with fiduciary duty to beneficiaries.

roles.title: Trust and Estate Attorney
roles.rationale: Structures and maintains the trusts and entities that hold family assets, and is consulted whenever an ownership-structure change affects who must appear as named insured.
roles.firms: Withers, McDermott Will & Emery, Day Pitney, Holland & Knight
roles.coi_influence: A structural change recommended here can force re-underwriting of the named insureds across the whole schedule.

roles.title: Private Banker
roles.rationale: Manages the family's core banking relationship and often finances or custodies the assets being insured, giving them early visibility into major acquisitions that should trigger a coverage review.
roles.firms: JPMorgan Private Bank, Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management, Citi Private Bank, UBS Global Wealth Management
roles.coi_influence: Often first to know of a major acquisition, well before the broker is looped in.

roles.title: Trust Officer
roles.rationale: Administers trust assets day to day on the trustee's behalf, executing routine instructions such as authorizing premium payment from trust funds without independent decision authority.
roles.firms: Northern Trust, Wilmington Trust, South Dakota Trust Company, Bessemer Trust

roles.title: Tax Director
roles.rationale: Owns the family's tax position across jurisdictions and structures, and is consulted whenever an insured asset's ownership or the principal's residency changes carries tax consequences alongside coverage ones.
roles.firms: EY Private Client Services, PwC Private Company Services, KPMG Family Office, Andersen
roles.coi_influence: Can push a coverage or ownership decision toward whichever entity minimizes the family's tax exposure.

roles.title: Family Office Chief Financial Officer
roles.rationale: Controls the family office's operating budget and cash flow, approving premium spend and reconciling claim proceeds against the family's consolidated books.
roles.firms: EisnerAmper Family Office Services, Withum Family Office Group, Agreus Group
roles.coi_influence: Controls the premium budget — effectively a soft veto over any program expansion.

roles.title: Personal & Family Office General Counsel
roles.rationale: In-house counsel who reviews policy wording, tracks the principal's D&O exposure arising from outside board seats, and directs outside counsel on coverage disputes and litigation.
roles.firms: Withers, McDermott Will & Emery, Major, Lindsey & Africa
roles.coi_influence: Reviews and can reject policy wording before the broker is authorized to bind.

roles.title: Family Office Chief Compliance Officer
roles.rationale: Owns the family office's own regulatory footprint (investment-adviser registration, AML/KYC on inbound funds) and is the accountable signatory for any compliance representation a carrier requires before binding.
roles.firms: ACA Group, Foreside Financial Group, Hardin Compliance Consulting
roles.coi_influence: Compliance sign-off is a hard gate before binding wherever the family office runs a registered investment adviser.

roles.title: Personal Cybersecurity & Digital Risk Consultant
roles.rationale: Performs the device- and household-network security assessment that cyber underwriters increasingly require before binding or renewing personal cyber coverage, and leads technical incident response if a policy is triggered.
roles.firms: BlackCloak, Kroll, Aon Cyber Solutions (Stroz Friedberg)
roles.coi_influence: A weak posture assessment here can stall or reprice a cyber renewal outright.

roles.title: Background Screening & Vetting Provider
roles.rationale: Vets household and protective staff before hire and periodically thereafter; underwriters treat documented staff-vetting practice as a material factor in K&R and premises-liability pricing.
roles.firms: Sterling, Kroll, Control Risks
roles.coi_influence: Documented vetting practice is itself an underwriting factor for K&R and premises-liability pricing.

roles.title: Personal Risk Insurance Broker
roles.rationale: The broker of record who architects and places the full personal-lines program — K&R, D&O, cyber, blanket articles, umbrella — and is the family's primary point of contact with the insurance market.
roles.firms: Marsh Private Client Services, Alliant Private Client, Risk Strategies, Aon Private Risk Management
roles.coi_influence: The single point of program-wide leverage — nearly every specialty line routes through this desk.

roles.title: Kidnap & Ransom (K&R) Specialist Broker
roles.rationale: A sub-specialist, often within the same brokerage, who places and negotiates K&R/extortion cover specifically given its bespoke wording, strict confidentiality terms, and narrow pool of willing underwriters.
roles.firms: Special Contingency Risks (SCR), Hiscox Special Risks, Willis Towers Watson
roles.coi_influence: Confidentiality terms mean this relationship is often the only channel with real visibility into the K&R policy at all.

roles.title: Crisis Response Consultancy
roles.rationale: The named response firm written directly into the K&R policy and mobilized on a covered kidnap, extortion, or detention event — pre-selected, delegated crisis authority rather than an ordinary claims vendor.
roles.firms: Control Risks, Ackerman Group, S-RM, Crisis24
roles.coi_influence: Named directly into policy wording — cannot be substituted mid-crisis without carrier consent.

roles.title: Specialty Personal Lines Underwriter
roles.rationale: Prices and binds the risk at the carrier and is the broker's direct counterparty for every quote, renewal, and mid-term endorsement across the program's lines.
roles.firms: Chubb, AIG Private Client Group, PURE Insurance, Cincinnati Private Client
roles.coi_influence: Appetite and capacity here can constrain what the broker is able to place at any price.

roles.title: Valuables Appraiser / Scheduling Specialist
roles.rationale: Produces the periodic independent valuations that support the blanket personal articles schedule, without which high-value art, jewelry, and collectibles cannot be insured to accurate value.
roles.firms: Winston Art Group, Doyle New York, AXA Art Appraisal Services
roles.coi_influence: An outdated valuation leaves a real coverage gap invisible until the claim.

roles.title: Private Client Real Estate Attorney
roles.rationale: Handles title and closing on residence purchases and sales, the trigger events that add or remove a property from the schedule of insured locations.
roles.firms: Katten Muchin Rosenman, Romer Debbas, Withers
roles.coi_influence: Closing delays here directly delay when coverage on the new location can incept.

roles.title: Art & Collectibles Advisor
roles.rationale: Advises on acquisition, provenance, and disposal of fine art and collectibles, producing the transaction records and valuations the broker needs to adjust articles coverage.
roles.firms: The Fine Art Group, Gurr Johns, Christie's Private Sales
roles.coi_influence: A provenance dispute surfaced here can void coverage on a piece already scheduled.

roles.title: Escrow / Title Agent
roles.rationale: Holds funds and confirms clear title at closing on a property or high-value vehicle purchase, the transactional vendor whose closing date fixes exactly when coverage must incept.
roles.firms: First American Title, Fidelity National Title, Chicago Title

roles.title: Residential Architect
roles.rationale: Designs new-build or major renovation projects; builder's-risk and the eventual homeowners policy are priced partly off the architect's specifications and construction materials.
roles.firms: Robert A.M. Stern Architects, Peter Marino Architect, Ferguson & Shamamian Architects
roles.coi_influence: Specification choices here set the construction-materials basis the builder's-risk quote is priced against.

roles.title: Construction Project Manager / Owner's Representative
roles.rationale: Runs the build on the principal's behalf with real decision authority over the project and is the point of contact for the builder's-risk policy covering the site until completion.
roles.firms: Turner & Townsend, Gardiner & Theobald, Cushman & Wakefield Project & Development Services
roles.coi_influence: The broker's actual day-to-day point of contact on an active build site, not the architect.

roles.title: Physical Security Systems Integrator
roles.rationale: Designs and installs perimeter security, safe rooms, and access control; K&R and property underwriters frequently condition pricing or terms on the installed security specification this role certifies.
roles.firms: Convergint Technologies, Kastle Systems, ADT Commercial
roles.coi_influence: Installed-spec certification is frequently a binding condition on K&R and property terms, not a suggestion.

roles.title: Director of Protective Services
roles.rationale: Runs the family's protective security operation and is the operational counterpart to the K&R broker and crisis response consultancy on threat assessment and protocol.
roles.firms: Gavin de Becker & Associates, Pinkerton, TorchStone Global
roles.coi_influence: Often the de facto underwriting counterpart on K&R terms, more than the broker itself.

roles.title: Household Manager
roles.rationale: Runs day-to-day household staff and operations at a residence, the delegate who typically reports a property loss or triggers an initial claim notification.
roles.firms: Polo & Tweed, Mahler Private Staffing, The Help Company
roles.coi_influence: First to report a loss in practice, regardless of the formal claims-reporting protocol.

roles.title: Estate Manager
roles.rationale: Oversees staff and operations across multiple residences, the operational point of contact for property-related claims and loss-control recommendations at each location.
roles.firms: Polo & Tweed, Mahler Private Staffing, The Help Company
roles.coi_influence: Coordinates loss-control fixes across multiple properties after a claim, not just one.

roles.title: Executive / Personal Assistant
roles.rationale: Manages the principal's schedule, travel, and correspondence and is frequently the first person to learn of a threat, loss, or travel change relevant to the program.
roles.firms: Beacon Hill Staffing Group, Solomon Page, Polo & Tweed
roles.coi_influence: Frequently the first person outside the family to learn of a loss, threat, or itinerary change.

roles.title: Executive Protection Agent
roles.rationale: Provides day-to-day close protection and secure transport for the principal and family, the trained frontline role whose deployment underwriters assess when pricing K&R and personal liability exposure.
roles.firms: Gavin de Becker & Associates, Pinkerton, TorchStone Global

roles.title: Private Chauffeur / Security Driver
roles.rationale: Drives the principal and family under a security-cleared protocol set by others, an operational frontline role with no independent authority over the program.
roles.firms: Pinkerton, Global Guardian, TorchStone Global

roles.title: Travel Risk & Security Manager
roles.rationale: Plans and risk-assesses the family's international travel, the single largest driver of K&R and medical-evacuation exposure, coordinating directly with the crisis response consultancy on itinerary risk.
roles.firms: International SOS, Crisis24, Control Risks
roles.coi_influence: Itinerary sign-off here is often the actual trigger for K&R and medevac policy activation.

roles.title: Medical Evacuation / Emergency Assistance Provider
roles.rationale: The named assistance company that arranges medical evacuation and emergency response abroad, typically written directly into travel and K&R policy wording.
roles.firms: International SOS, Global Rescue, AirMed International
roles.coi_influence: Named directly into policy wording as the assistance company of record.

roles.title: Concierge / Lifestyle Manager
roles.rationale: Arranges private events, travel logistics, and guest hosting at family properties, activities that generate the liability and premises exposure the broker needs visibility into.
roles.firms: Quintessentially, Ten Lifestyle Group, John Paul

roles.title: Family Office Chief Operating Officer
roles.rationale: Runs the family office's internal operations and vendor relationships day to day and is typically the administrative counterpart who schedules renewals and routes broker correspondence to the right principal-side signatory.
roles.firms: EisnerAmper Family Office Services, Withum Family Office Group, Agreus Group
roles.coi_influence: Administrative routing point — controls which principal-side signatory a renewal actually reaches.

roles.title: Multi-Family Office (Outsourced) Provider
roles.rationale: Where the family does not run a dedicated single-family office, an outsourced multi-family office performs the same program-coordination function across several unrelated families as a shared-service delegate.
roles.firms: Bessemer Trust, Pitcairn, Cresset, Stonehage Fleming
